clauses.text: The board starts from the card

steps.do: Power the Pi 5 with the written card and the serial console open.
steps.expect: The bootloader prints lines on the serial console and the activity LED blinks.
`Linux version 6.12.115-iyakki-rpi5` and kernel messages follow the bootloader lines.
`stage1: volumes found` names an mmcblk or nvme boot and data volume, then `boot volume mounted`.

clauses.text: The system starts from the seed root

steps.expect: `root boot/root.sfs mounted`, `switching root`, then the IYAKKI system starts (banner or login).

clauses.text: The data volume is formatted once and kept

steps.expect: The second start says `stage1: data volume mounted`.
The board gets a DHCP address (serial console or router list).
The boot picture or the shell; a black screen with a working serial console is a valid answer: choose fail and say so.

steps.do: Collect the serial log, a photo of the screen, boot/stage1.log from the card, the board revision line and the bootloader date.
steps.expect: Everything is sent to the project.
